evaluation.results_summary: The developer states that the model combines the strengths of the Qwen and Ultima architectures through an optimized fusion, aiming to improve reasoning, multilingual comprehension, and multi-turn conversation.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer notes that hallucinations and biases may still exist, despite strengths in structured reasoning and multilingual understanding.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Card explicitly reports hallucinations may still exist despite strengths in structured reasoning and multilingual understanding.

specifications.model_size: 19.2 GiB of safetensors weights (20,661,818,136 bytes) in U8
